lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular spacing, forming a staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid where the high-luminance blobs serve as nodes. This is most prominent in the region between the gills and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical luminance transition, with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.
